deepseek.observed_student: Read the calculator source and correctly identified both root causes; no code change.
deepseek.observed_transport: Three HTTP 200 Responses exchanges; the third completed with reasoning and assistant text but no function call; Codex recorded turn.completed.
deepseek.attribution: unresolved: the downstream evidence proves an early completed turn, not whether the provider chose to stop or the gateway omitted a continuation/tool call. Raw provider response was not preserved at that boundary.

minimax.observed_student: 42 completed command executions; 38 exit zero. Student inspected source, repeatedly tried HDC reconnection, and did not modify target source. Exit zero does not prove semantic success.
minimax.observed_environment: Device target preflight succeeded. The task bridge recorded connection closure during the run and, at 09:51:02 and 09:51:14 local time, host target connection refused. The isolated emulator guest kernel log ended at 09:49:57, approximately 1,798 seconds after emulator boot; exact shutdown cause is not established.
minimax.attribution: late device unavailability is a verified environmental observation. Earlier connection-loss cause remains unresolved. Device unavailability prevents an independent assessment of end-to-end device execution. Student troubleshooting choices remain observable but do not prove inability to complete in a stable environment.

confirmed_harness_findings.evidence: Entry script starts HDC server at 127.0.0.1:18710 but does not export OHOS_HDC_SERVER_PORT; HDC verbose help says default 8710. Student item_15 runs hdc list targets without -s and output includes Connect server failed.
confirmed_harness_findings.independent_control: Same HDC binary in separate network-isolated container, no emulator or participant: with only server at 18710, default list says Connect server failed; explicit -s 127.0.0.1:18710 or OHOS_HDC_SERVER_PORT=18710 returns [Empty]. All three return shell exit code 0, so compare output.
confirmed_harness_findings.scope: Confirmed harness defect; does not explain every disconnect or prove student outcome in a repaired environment.

confirmed_harness_findings.finding: Device bridge absolute 240 second connection deadline
confirmed_harness_findings.evidence: Task bridge source sets deadline to monotonic()+240 on connection and never refreshes it after successful traffic.
confirmed_harness_findings.scope: Confirmed latent harness design issue; first observed connection lasted about 67.75 seconds, so this timeout cannot explain that first closure.

restart_strategy.ordering: Repair default HDC address and verify sustained availability first; restart only after independent health checks show device unavailable.
restart_strategy.safety: Keep exact same isolated device and workspace; preserve state and operator evidence before lifecycle action; classify interruptions as environment events, not teacher help.
restart_strategy.uncertainty: Never replay an interrupted command with unknown side effects; independently read back state before deciding continuation. Any reset invalidating task state means a new separately identified attempt.
restart_strategy.validation: Qualify readiness, HDC target persistence, bounded backoff and restart exhaustion separately before use in an assessment; compare with a no-restart negative control.

task_isolated_repair.status: task-specific successor scripts prepared and individually exercised; not deployed to the generic production Harness
fixes: Set OHOS_HDC_SERVER_PORT=18710 in participant entry; pass it through container preflight.
Use the successor task paths in preflight.
Remove fixed 240 second device-bridge connection deadline; model connection deadline unchanged.
verification: HDC default-port isolated control: before failed to connect, after connected to the configured server.

Fresh isolated Harmony emulator: device connected and five consecutive HDC shell commands succeeded through repaired bridge.
Stopped and cold-started the same isolated emulator; a marker written to its data partition before restart was read back after restart.
Test emulator and bridge stopped after verification.
limits: Automatic health monitoring, bounded automatic restart and unknown-operation reconciliation are not implemented or validated.
